from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression
from sklearn.metrics import mean_absolute_error

s = s.sort_values(["shop_id", "date"]).reset_index(drop=True)
X = prep(s)
y = s["revenue_k"]
tr = s["date"] < "2025-04-01"

history = s[tr].assign(weekday=s.loc[tr,'date'].dt.weekday).sort_values('date')
last = history.groupby(['shop_id','weekday'])['revenue_k'].last()
lag7 = pd.Series([last.loc[(r.shop_id,r.date.weekday())] for r in s.itertuples()], index=s.index)
mae_lag7 = round(mean_absolute_error(y[~tr], lag7[~tr]), 2)
lin = LinearRegression().fit(X[tr], y[tr])
mae_lin = round(mean_absolute_error(y[~tr], lin.predict(X[~tr])), 2)
lin_better = mae_lin < mae_lag7
_saved_X = X.copy()
_saved_lag = lag7.copy()
_changed = s.copy()
_future = _changed.date >= "2025-04-01"
_changed.loc[_future,"revenue_k"] += 1000000
_changed.loc[_future,"temp"] = 99
_changed.loc[_future,"rain"] = 1
assert prep(_changed).equals(_saved_X), "Future facts changed issued features"
_changed_history = _changed[~_future].assign(weekday=_changed.loc[~_future,"date"].dt.weekday).sort_values("date")
_changed_last = _changed_history.groupby(["shop_id","weekday"])["revenue_k"].last()
_changed_lag = pd.Series([_changed_last.loc[(r.shop_id,r.date.weekday())] for r in _changed.itertuples()],index=_changed.index)
assert _changed_lag.equals(_saved_lag), "Future cash changed issued calendar forecast"

import time
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingRegressor, HistGradientBoostingRegressor, RandomForestRegressor
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error

d = pd.read_csv("deliveries.csv", parse_dates=["created"])
ok = d[d["actual_min"].between(1, 299)].copy()
ok["hour"] = ok["created"].dt.hour
X = pd.get_dummies(ok[["distance_km", "items", "hour", "courier", "weather", "shop_id"]], dtype=int)
y = ok["actual_min"]
X_tr, X_te, y_tr, y_te = train_test_split(X, y, test_size=0.25, random_state=42)

models = {
    "GradientBoosting": GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=200, max_depth=3, random_state=0),
    "HistGradientBoosting": HistGradientBoostingRegressor(max_iter=200, max_depth=3, random_state=0),
    "RandomForest": RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, min_samples_leaf=5, random_state=0),
}

rows = []
for name, model in models.items():
    fit_s = timed_fit(name, model, X_tr, y_tr)
    pred, predict_ms = timed_predict(name, model, X_te)

    rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_te, pred))
    rows.append({"model": name, "rmse": round(float(rmse), 3), "fit_s": fit_s, "predict_ms": predict_ms})

table = pd.DataFrame(rows).set_index("model").sort_values("rmse")
best = table.index[0]
fastest_fit = table["fit_s"].idxmin()
print(table.round(3))
print("лучший:", best, "| быстрее всех обучился:", fastest_fit)
